_about: The Loom's mission, machine-readable (Danny 18:20). The planner reads this every pulse so the loop knows what it is for, how far it is, and what it may not do. Source of truth for the endpoint and guards: tools/project_docs/WEAVE_NODE_CHARTER.md; for the method: LOOM_METHODS_DATASHEET.md.
goal: Derive and test the Weave unified field equation: one central equation whose three fields (S, T, U) balance every node with real predictions, not fits.

endpoint.E1: every node BALANCED, or TRUST with a written reason and a countersign (G-T2)
endpoint.E3: four corners agree for every shared quantity
endpoint.E4: no fit posing as a prediction; prediction/FIT/TRUST counts published

MN.derive: M_N from the S modulus (no x1.49 rescale)

m32.derive: W0 / m3/2 without using the wino window

TR.derive: T_R from the inflaton couplings (no x1.49 rescale)

guards.G-T1: relabelling STRAINED->TRUST/FIT is a null round, not progress
guards.G-T2: every TRUST needs a written reason plus a referee countersign
guards.G-T3: the FIT+TRUST count must not rise between rounds
guards.G-T4: killable predictions >= killable_min and must not fall
guards.G-T5: a node with nothing derived scores zero predictions
guards.G-T6: a round is null when the prediction/FIT/TRUST ledger is unchanged
guards.LOCK: lock (PREREG + .sha256, pushed) before any computation; DEVIATIONS before any rerun; no reruns to chase results; never loosen a tolerance
guards.HONEST: estimate vs computed vs literature; corrections as dated notes, never silent edits
guards.HUMAN: no Zenodo/arXiv without Danny's 'Publish'; no passwords; emails stay drafts; downloads need Danny's OK; never edit serapis_v3*.tex; don't touch the PC repo git

owed.what: automated check: every PASS in a verdict file carries FIT / NO-POWER / CONDITIONAL where one applies
the prediction / FIT / TRUST ledger file (field_tests/loom/pft_ledger.json) with honest relabels
paper Docs artifact: add the D1948 corrections (Br <= 2.3 %, alpha_s conditional)
verify the Conlon-Palti internal quote against the source
